summary: Comprehensive E2E testing of 'Change Yourself' 30-day fitness challenge app. Backend: 14/14 pytest cases pass (auth, profile, calories, workouts, meals, weight progress, Claude Sonnet 4.5 chat). Frontend: full signup → onboarding → tabs flow validated on mobile viewport (390x844). Body-part picker on Workout tab correctly swaps exercises (Belly: Plank → Chest: Push Ups). Diet tab plan switching persists goal and updates calorie target (2286 kcal fat_loss → 3086 kcal muscle_gain). Home screen renders streak, day counter, kcal target, protein, TDEE. Re-login of returning user with profile goes directly to home (no onboarding re-prompt). No critical issues found.

minor.issue: History replay re-sends previous user messages to LLM on every chat call (loop in lines 383-388 of server.py). Works correctly but doubles token cost and adds latency. Consider passing history as part of context once, or relying on session_id state.

issues: Bottom-tab buttons (HOME/WORKOUT/DIET/COACH/PROFILE) have no testID attributes — testing must rely on text content. Recommend adding testID='tab-<name>' to Tabs.Screen options for robust automation.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning in expo.err.log: 'Image: style.resizeMode is deprecated. Please use props.resizeMode.' Multiple occurrences — non-blocking but should be migrated.
Installed v3.0.2 but Expo expects v2.2.0 — compatibility warning in metro logs.

action_items: Add testID to bottom Tabs (e.g., tabBarTestID='tab-workout') in /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/_layout.tsx for stable UI automation.
Migrate Image style.resizeMode → props.resizeMode to silence deprecation warnings.
Align @react-native-async-storage/async-storage to 2.2.0 with `yarn add @react-native-async-storage/async-storage@2.2.0` to match Expo expectation.
Optional: optimize /api/chat to avoid replaying history through the LLM on each request (token/latency cost).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py /api/chat replays last 10 user messages through LLM via send_message before responding — inflates token usage and response time. Recommend not pre-sending history; rely on LlmChat session_id, or include compact summary in system_message.
server.py exceptions surface raw LLM error string in HTTP 500 detail (`AI coach unavailable: {e}`) — could leak internals. Return generic message and log details server-side only.

PUT /api/profile sets challenge_start on first ANY profile update, even partial (e.g., updating only weight from Profile tab) — could prematurely start the 30-day counter. Consider requiring core fields (age, gender, height, weight, goal) to be present.

success_rate.frontend: 100% on tested flows (signup, onboarding, home, workout body-picker + complete, diet plan switch, re-login)

seed_data_creation: Each pytest/UI run registers a fresh unique email (test_<uuid>@cy.com / ui_<uuid>@cy.com). No DB cleanup performed — left in MongoDB for inspection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend public URL: EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL=https://slim-challenge-5.preview.emergentagent.com. Run `pytest /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`. Frontend bottom tabs lack testIDs — use page.get_by_text('WORKOUT'/'DIET'/'COACH'/'PROFILE').first.click(force=True) for tab nav. Chat tab can also be reached via home-chat-cta testID. Onboarding is a single screen with testIDs onb-gender-male/female, onb-age, onb-height, onb-weight, onb-target, onb-goal-{fat_loss|muscle_gain|healthy}, onb-activity-{sedentary|light|moderate|active|very_active}, onb-focus-{belly|chest|arms|legs|waist|full_body}, onb-submit.
